verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an AI use-case titled 'Investigate What Changed After a Deploy' (signoz-docs-26). It suggests deploy-related regression investigation through AI agents connected via the MCP server (signoz-docs-25). Nothing in the pack documents first-class release or change tracking. Missing for 10: deploy/release markers or annotations on charts, configuration-change event ingestion or tracking, version-based comparison of regressions, in-depth docs for the deploy-investigation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
